fields.name: Notification indicator IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for Notification indicator

fields.name: Length of notification indicator contents
fields.description: Length of the notification indicator contents

fields.name: Notification indicator value
fields.description: Notification indicator value. Bit pattern 0000001 indicates SRVCC handover cancelled, IMS session re-establishment required (see 3GPP TS 23.216 [8]). Bit patterns 00000010 to 01111111 are unused and shall be ignored if received by the UE. All other values are reserved.

notes: The Notification indicator is a type 4 information element with 3 octets length.

The purpose of the Notification indicator information element is to inform the UE about an event which is relevant for the upper layer using an EPS bearer context or having requested a procedure transaction.
